import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class Link extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        href: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        target: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        rel: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        disabled: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        appearance: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        size: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        underline: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
    };
    href: string;
    target: string;
    rel: string;
    disabled: boolean;
    appearance: string;
    size: string;
    underline: boolean;
    constructor();
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
